creator: laredson
releaseBasis: PMM 1.3.0 RC30 preserves the complete RC22-RC29 feature and regression chain, then removes the verified idle/UI refresh hot paths and simplifies the local-first AI workflow. Routed child selections no longer rebuild tabs or reset the feedback merge selector; validation updates only the affected row, uses large DPI-aware controls and can route a successful exact merge directly to manual Knowledge feedback. AI assistance shows the selected case or an explicit new-case form, AI reception accepts routed responses and self-describing standalone theme drafts, and Vanilla Game Reference is restored to normal Settings. Nothing is uploaded automatically and returned AI data remains inactive until explicit review.
dependencyPolicy: Public v1.3.0 bundles and verifies repak, mappings, prebuilt PMMCore, AssetReader, PMMFixLab, and the pinned portable .NET Runtime 8.0.30. Healthy startup performs local verification only. Network repair is attempted only when a required redistributable is missing or invalid, with bounded download timeouts.
releasePackagingPolicy: Portable PMM folder: only PMM.exe plus Engine, Modules, Resources, CKL and Documentation. Workspace is created at runtime and contains all user/generated state. Repository-only source, QA and maintainer docs are not shipped in the user package.
gameReferenceProgressUi: Shared normal Settings + Fix Lab progress bars plus both Game Reference buttons as ColorFlow progress surfaces. AUTO invokes the canonical Settings Game Reference command before Fix Lab navigation; output choice may be highlighted concurrently while the worker runs.
uiContract: Public tabs are Mods & Merge, FIX LAB, AI & Help, Saves and Settings. Fresh size is 1460x900 and the normal minimum is 900x600; startup clamps to the Windows work area in device-independent pixels. Branding and action areas occupy equal header halves. Header actions are ordered Detect/status, folder/Play controls, then AUTO. AI & Help contains five focused subtabs: AI assistance, AI reception, Feedback & Knowledge, color-scheme editor and AI settings. Normal Settings also owns Vanilla Game Reference. General Settings follows the Sound events architecture by separating official PMM schemes from a bordered user-scheme collection. ColorFlow ends by highlighting Play as optional readiness without an action-required popup.
themeUiOwnership: The eleven release JSON schemes plus legacy Night and Light appear under Official PMM schemes. Valid definitions under Workspace/Themes appear separately under User schemes and cannot shadow official IDs.
themeImportContract: Settings accepts bounded PMM_COLOR_SCHEME_V1 JSON/ZIP data with parse-all-before-commit, official-id protection, user replacement confirmation/backup, unsafe-path/symlink/executable/nested-archive rejection and a 4.5:1 contrast matrix. The AI & Help editor creates PMM_COLOR_SCHEME_V1 or image-backed PMM_COLOR_SCHEME_V2 definitions, installs them locally as user schemes and exports V2 as a PMM_THEME_PACK_V1 ZIP with local PNG/JPEG assets, hashes and solid fallback colors. Official schemes load only from the release hash manifest; user schemes live separately under Workspace/Themes.
progressPresentation: Determinate bars lag but never exceed worker-reported progress. Each newly proven range below completion advances in integer points over approximately three seconds; a newer report may catch the display up only to the previous proven target before animating onward. A confirmed 100% update always jumps immediately to 100 and clears pending animation before the next task begins.
analyzeVariantPreflight: PMM Fix Lab Gawr Gura outputs are mutually exclusive. If any two known complete outputs are active, Analyze pauses before PAK asset enumeration for an explicit PackageChoice and suppresses the unselected output from analysis/deployment after confirmation.
mergeOutputModel: Preserve original mods and generate only the PMM compatibility patch needed for conflicting content.
savedPatchReusePolicy: Exact active source hashes/mappings allow immediate reuse. After a current Analyze, a physical patch may also be reused when every patched asset, provider identity/hash, adapter mode, decision signature, automatic-resolution signature, mappings identity, Vanilla identity and output-relevant priority winner still match. KnownRecipeAuto additionally requires the current production recipe identity and exact saved cooked-output evidence. Runtime-proven semantic DataTable resolutions require their exact path/provider/value tuple and pin the production-rule library hash in schema-18 plans, Analyze caches and schema-9 manifests. Unique/non-conflicting source PAK differences do not require rebuilding the overlay; Deploy still synchronizes the active source set. PatchContentSignature records generated cooked output evidence.
releaseValidationLog: repository validation output / Workspace/Logs for runtime support

host.startupSplashSource: packaged PMM.exe is the unchanged RC21 binary authority carried into RC24; the repository native-source snapshot requires reconciliation before rebuilding the splash host
host.startupForegroundHandoff: WPF reports startup:UI-shell-ready:<HWND>; PMM.exe activates that HWND before destroying the splash.

fullLanguageCompatibility.note: v1.3.0 keeps native Host/Runtime startup and the native Win32 shell independent of PowerShell FullLanguage. The full Analyze/Build/Deploy/Saves/Fix Lab workspace remains on the WPF/Core PowerShell path on FullLanguage systems. PMM does not weaken or bypass Windows application-control policy.

runtime.editableUiProcessCreation: CREATE_NO_WINDOW without SW_HIDE; console suppressed while WPF top-level window remains normally visible/activatable.

aiioAssistanceFlow: New case selects an explicit PMM feature and description, then either saves locally or creates the safe manual AI ZIP directly. Selecting an existing case shows that exact case on the right and reuses its active exchange.
aiioReceptionFlow: Standard PMM_AI_RESPONSE_V2 ZIPs route by embedded sessionId. Exact standalone cooked solutions remain case-bound. A self-describing PMM_THEME_AI_RESPONSE_V1 ZIP may be received without a prior visible case and opens only as an uninstalled draft.
aiioFeedbackTransport: inspectable local JSON and manual sharing only; PMM_FEEDBACK_TRANSPORT_V1 is a disabled future boundary
aiioCandidatePolicy: All returned candidates are staged as untrusted data. Only an exact PMM_MANUAL_SOLUTION_V1 candidate matching the current case, hashes and topology can be explicitly activated; activation forces Analyze and never triggers Build or Deploy.

ckl.discovery: Analyze uses the catalog to shortlist knowledge by asset/provider identity before loading detailed entries.
ckl.safety: Catalog matches are context only. Automatic output requires a normal proven adapter, an exact hash-pinned production recipe, or an enabled runtime-proven semantic rule matching the exact asset path, competing provider set and canonical value tuple. Semantic rules resolve only the declared field and still rebuild from current cooked families.
ckl.remoteInstallPolicy: Local Stable/Experimental catalog is active. Unsigned automatic network installation is disabled until a signed/versioned CKL artifact contract is published.

wpfWorkspaceProcessModel: The editable WPF workspace is loaded by a hidden PowerShell child process on FullLanguage systems; PMM.exe remains the supervised native launcher. Windows Shell identity is explicitly branded as PMM.
guidedWorkflowProgress: ColorFlow and AUTO both call the same workflow-state resolver. Only the next unresolved action is highlighted. Detect remains visible but is disabled after a valid installation is confirmed. Fix Lab dependencies and choices are inserted only when an exact supported legacy source is present. A current deployment highlights Play as an optional ready state and never presents it as an action-required step.
externalModsDetection: Startup + window activation + 2-second metadata fingerprint (PAK name/size/mtime). Hashing is only escalated for a changed same-size candidate, never for the full mod set heartbeat.
modLibrarySelection: Extended multi-selection: Ctrl/Shift/Ctrl+A plus Select all/Clear selection directly below the imported-mod list. Enable, disable and delete operate on all selected source mods; priority move controls require exactly one selection.
importUi: Import... opens one modal chooser with two actions: Import mods... selects one or multiple PAK/ZIP/7Z/RAR files; Import folder... imports all supported mod files directly contained in one chosen folder. ZIP/7Z/RAR files are extraction containers only; PMM stores their extracted PAK files, never the source archive.
operationCompletionUi: Successful workflow operations do not show informational OK MessageBox popups. Completion remains visible in persistent progress/status surfaces. Errors and explicit Yes/No decisions remain modal when necessary.
savedMergeManagementUi: Compatibility patches expose Validate merge and Delete merge. Build & Deploy exposes DEPLOY and UNDEPLOY. UNDEPLOY removes only the selected exact game copy; Delete removes the exact deployed copy plus matching saved copies/manifests and validation/selection state. There is no user-facing Archive action.

fixLab.case001: five local recipe-generated outputs from either exact v5 Normal or FullReplacement source
fixLab.ui: responsive collapsible Fix Lab workflow with an always-visible manual Refresh action and deferred, sixty-second cached tab refresh

automaticWorkflow.trigger: AUTO runs once from the current state; Auto ON continues after any manually started flow action.
automaticWorkflow.fixLabPolicy: Exact supported legacy identities route before normal Analyze. If current Game Reference is required, AUTO invokes the internal background Game Reference worker immediately without changing tabs. Shared progress remains visible in Settings and Fix Lab. Multiple outputs remain a concurrent human choice while the reference builds; once both reference and choice are ready, AUTO continues Repair -> Apply Fix -> Analyze -> Build -> Deploy -> optional Palworld.
automaticWorkflow.tabNavigationPolicy: AUTO never forces the selected PMM tab merely to obtain Fix Lab state. Human navigation remains under user control.

operationCancellation.synchronousOperations: cooperative cancellation via progress callbacks and cancel-aware external archive processes
operationCancellation.deployPolicy: verified rollback when cancellation occurs after managed-file commit begins

validationDialog: DPI-aware fixed modal with a 1040 x 360 client surface, 230 x 76 answer buttons and a second explicit Knowledge-contribution prompt after PASS/PASS_RECONFIRMED.
backgroundCadence: No permanent 500 ms UI-responsiveness diagnostic. External ~mods metadata heartbeat runs every 60 seconds only while the main window is active, visible and no processing operation is running. Analyze/Build/AIIO/GameReference progress polling exists only for the lifetime of its child worker.

processArchitecture.workerModel: one shared engine implementation; normally one fresh short-lived process per job

release: PMM v1.3.0 RC29 AI & Help feedback and UI fix release candidate
fixLabCase001ProviderMatrix: PASS: exact Normal and exact FullReplacement each generated all five outputs with PAK v11 readback and byte-exact entry verification on the captured reference.
fixLabMountPolicy: Deployable repair outputs must end in _P.pak so same-path cooked assets receive Unreal patch priority over the vanilla provider.
mergeLifecyclePolicy: game ~mods is deployment state only; Builds/Current and Builds/Previous are saved/internal history. Discovery never silently recreates a saved build from a deployed merge. Only explicit Compatibility patches actions may change a deployed merge: Deploy with the selected patch or No compatibility patch, UNDEPLOY, or Delete merge. Fix Lab Apply/Restore and source-mod Delete preserve the deployed PMM merge PAK, sidecar, patch state and selection. UNDEPLOY removes only the selected exact deployed PAK+sidecar. Delete merge removes the exact deployed copy plus matching saved copies/manifests and validation/selection state; same-name different-hash files are protected.

completionSound.policy: Manual workflow steps chime individually. AUTO/Auto ON plays the configured Semiauto cue after each successful step when enabled, then plays Auto once when the complete chain reaches its terminal successful state.
completionSound.level: modest/medium-low, mastered in the WAV because System.Media.SoundPlayer has no per-instance volume control

analyzeCachePolicy.pakIndexContents: repak list entry names only; no cooked asset bytes
analyzeCachePolicy.pakIndexFingerprint: canonical full path + file length + LastWriteTimeUtc
analyzeCachePolicy.groupFingerprint: merge schema + engine id + mappings SHA-256 + vanilla quick signature + production compatibility-rule SHA-256 + asset key/kind + provider name/hash/priority
neverCached: any result containing a decision row
analyzeCachePolicy.exactPlanReuse: Only a schema-18 plan with zero decision rows and exclusively the safe cached modes may be reused, and only when source, priority, mappings, vanilla and compatibility-rule signatures still match.
analyzeCachePolicy.effectivePatchReuse: Automatic schema-9 patches persist every analyzed shared-asset topology proof. When only unrelated unique PAKs change, current shared topology plus exact provider hashes can reuse the patch before expensive adapters. KnownRecipeAuto also requires pinned RecipeId/output provider and exact output evidence. DataTable automatic compatibility rules require an identical stored rule signature. Both forms require an unchanged production-recipe library hash. Older plans and manifests without those proofs re-enter normal Analyze. If the fast proof is unavailable, normal Analyze runs and then compares the complete effective patch recipe before deciding whether Build is necessary.
analyzeCachePolicy.forceAnalyze: Force bypasses exact-plan and group-result reuse; PAK fingerprints still prevent stale indexes.

settingsDefaults.scope: interface, ColorFlow action-hint duration and workflow audio only
